blurb: Guests take private scenic flights in a Cessna 172 aircraft piloted by commercially licensed pilots. Flights offer views of Niagara Falls, Toronto skyline, and lakeshore panoramas. The Pilot Experience allows guests to sit up front and hold the controls during the flight.
extraNote: Prices are per person; Lakeshore Panorama $99 per person only for groups of 3 · Flights are private; no strangers onboard; no joining other groups · If weather unsafe (strong winds, low visibility, heavy snow), flight rescheduled at no extra cost · Experience gift certificates valid for 1 year; monetary value cards never expire
